# Learned instinct: ansible-fqcn-required (confidence 1)

All Ansible module calls must use Fully Qualified Collection Names (FQCN). Short-form names (e.g., `copy:` instead of `ansible.builtin.copy:`) cause ambiguity when multiple collections are installed and are rejected by ansible-lint. No exceptions, including in handlers and import_tasks.

Source: ansible-lint rule [fqcn]; Ansible Galaxy collection docs
